caption:
everyone warns you about year one.

nobody warns you about the years after.

what year are you in? 👇

slides.text:
everyone says most businesses fail in year one
so i looked it up

slides.query: what percent of new businesses fail in the first year
slides.result: About **1 in 5** new US businesses close within their first year.
slides.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Business Employment Dynamics
slides.image: laptop dark room late nights work

slides.query: what percent of businesses survive 5 years
slides.result: Roughly **half** are still open after five years.
slides.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Business Employment Dynamics
slides.image: dark laptop headphones bed night focus

slides.text:
so year one isn't where most people stop
it's the years after
slides.image: treadmill by window running in place stuck

slides.text:
the boring years
the ones nobody films

year one is excitement
year two is where you find out if you meant it

if you're in the middle years
you're in the part that counts
slides.image: pull up silhouette sunset rise rebuild
